# @dxtmisha/functional-basic

> Foundational isomorphic utility library for modern web and SSR development — framework-agnostic, TypeScript-first.

Core library providing a robust HTTP client with SSR hydration, multi-layer client and server state storage, centralized error routing, i18n localization and formatting, SEO metadata, URL state synchronization, DOM event management, search filtering, and pure data utilities.

## Key Classes & Utilities

- [Api / ApiInstance / ApiCache / ApiHydration / ApiError](src/classes/Api.ts): Isomorphic HTTP client with request interceptors, SSR state hydration, response caching, mock emulation, structured error metadata (`ApiDataReturn`, `ApiStatus`), and timeout/abort controller support.
- [ErrorCenter / ErrorCenterInstance / ErrorCenterHandler](src/classes/ErrorCenter.ts): Request-isolated centralized error routing, group handlers, and telemetry callbacks replacing direct `console.error` calls.
- [DataStorage / CookieStorage / Cookie / CookieBlock / ServerStorage](src/classes/DataStorage.ts): Isomorphic storage abstractions for `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, RFC 6265bis cookies (with `SameSite`, `Secure`, `Partitioned`), and request-isolated SSR server storage.
- [Cache / CacheItem / CacheStatic](src/classes/Cache.ts): In-memory and asynchronous computation cache with dependency keys, concurrent promise deduplication, and stale-revision guards.
- [Geo / GeoInstance / GeoLocation / GeoList / GeoTimezone](src/classes/Geo.ts): BCP-47 locale resolution, ISO 3166-1 country/language metadata, and timezone offset formatting.
- [GeoIntl / Formatters / Datetime / GeoPhone / GeoUnit / GeoFlag](src/classes/GeoIntl.ts): Native `Intl`-based formatting for numbers, currencies, file sizes, dates, relative time, pluralization, phone masks (`getByPhone`, `getByPhoneFull`, `toMask`), measurement unit conversion, and country flags.
- [Translate / TranslateInstance / TranslateFile](src/classes/Translate.ts): Asynchronous locale-isolated translation loader with request batching and fallback resolution.
- [Meta / MetaManager / MetaOg / MetaTwitter / MetaStatic](src/classes/Meta.ts): Isomorphic SEO manager synchronizing `<title>`, standard meta tags, Open Graph (`og:*`), and Twitter Cards (`twitter:*`).
- [Query / Hash / UrlItem / UrlInstanceAbstract](src/classes/Query.ts): URL query parameter and hash state management with history preservation and change listeners.
- [SearchList / SearchListMatcher / SearchListData / SearchListOptions](src/classes/SearchList.ts): Multi-column search filtering engine with regex escaping and XSS-safe HTML match highlighting (`addTagHighlightMatch`, `getArrayHighlightMatch`).
- [EventItem / BroadcastMessage / ResumableTimer / ScrollbarWidth / Loading / Icons](src/classes/EventItem.ts): Leak-safe DOM event listeners (with `ResizeObserver` and `requestAnimationFrame` throttling), cross-tab `BroadcastChannel` messaging, resumable timers, scrollbar measurement, global loading state, and icon registry.
- [functions](src/functions): 140+ pure isomorphic utilities for type guards (`isFilled`, `isFunction`, `isObject`, `isObjectNotArray`, `isArray`, `isString`, `isNumber`, `isNull`, `isDomRuntime`), execution (`executeFunction`, `executePromise`, `sleep`, `frame`), object/array manipulation (`copyObject`, `forEach`, `forOwn`, `replaceRecursive`, `splice`, `getItemByPath`, `getColumn`, `uniqueArray`, `sortList`, `intersectKey`, `getObjectByKeys`, `getObjectNoUndefined`, `getObjectNull`), string/number conversion (`toNumber`, `toNumberPositive`, `toNumberByMax`, `toPercent`, `toPercentBy100`, `toCamelCase`, `toKebabCase`, `toPascalCase`, `capitalize`, `anyToString`, `transformation`, `uint8ArrayToBase64`, `blobToBase64`), security (`encodeAttribute`, `encodeLiteAttribute`, `escapeExp`, `getElementSafeScript`, `isPrototypeKey`, `removeTag`), and DOM/browser helpers (`createElement`, `setElementItem`, `getElement`, `isElementVisible`, `goScroll`, `goScrollSmooth`, `goScrollTo`, `getClipboardData`, `writeClipboardData`, `handleShare`, `resizeImage`).
